system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: A unified instruction build system generates CLI-specific instruction files from shared templates
system_prompt_style.note: Instructions built from common/, cli_specific/, roles/ templates into CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md; underlying CLI composes its own system prompt.

env_context_strategy.note: Navigation delegated to underlying CLI (Claude Code default). Project context files context/{name}.md also referenced.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: `/clear` wipes session memory and resets costs. Layers 1–3 persist as files, so nothing is lost.
context_compaction.note: Closest value: /clear reset with file-based recovery (structured YAML queue) resembles structured_checkpoint; also slim_yaml archives read messages. Underlying CLI compaction not in evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: AI instantly reads and analyzes your screen captures
observation_format.note: Inter-agent messages are YAML files; tool observation formatting is done by underlying CLIs.

tool_call_format.note: Tool-call parsing is performed by wrapped CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, etc.); no parser in this harness's evidence.

tool_count.note: Tools come from wrapped CLIs; no tool schema list in evidence. Repo ships .opencode/tools/mark-as-read.ts.

edit_primitive.note: Editing handled by underlying CLI tools; not defined in this harness.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: MCP servers give Claude access to external tools
tool_schema_source.note: Custom tool .opencode/tools/mark-as-read.ts hand-written; MCP servers configured.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: bash first_setup.sh # one-time setup: config, dependencies, MCP

loop_primitives.note: Each agent is a CLI ReAct loop; coordination via inbox file events.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Shogun delegates → Karo breaks it down → 7 Ashigaru execute in parallel.
planning_granularity.note: Task YAMLs with blockedBy dependencies stored in queue/tasks/.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Orchestrate parallel AI tasks via tmux with shogun → karo → ashigaru hierarchy.
multi_agent_topology.note: Shogun -> Karo -> 7 Ashigaru + Gunshi by default.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Agents talk through YAML files on disk.
delegation_mechanism.note: Per-agent inbox YAML files with flock plus tmux nudges.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Appears in dashboard.md → You approve → Skill created in .claude/commands/
human_in_loop.note: Human approves skill candidates; agents run with bypass permissions so no per-action approval.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Task management — source of truth for instructions and reports

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Shogun reads `memory/MEMORY.md` at every session start.
long_term_memory.note: Also Memory MCP knowledge graph (memory/shogun_memory.jsonl) and skills/.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Old cmds remain in `queue/` as history, and the Shogun restores state when resumed
state_persistence.note: State recovery from YAML queue after /clear; startup resets queue files.

self_verification.evidence_quote: quality review, evidence review, RCA, adoption/drop decisions, architecture/design review, and deploy blocker classification are routed to Gunshi
self_verification.note: Separate agent reviews; prompt-driven, not code-enforced in evidence.

retry_policy.note: No retry config surface in evidence; tests/e2e/e2e_redo.bats suggests redo exists.

rollback.note: Rollback depends on underlying CLI; no evidence.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: When a blocking task completes, the Karo automatically unblocks dependent tasks
termination_condition.note: Agents report completion in YAML; system is long-running; other caps belong to wrapped CLIs.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: The `cost_group` field links each model to your subscription plan

timeouts.evidence_quote: `send-keys` transmits only a short wake-up signal (timeout 5s)
timeouts.note: Timeout on nudge delivery, not agent actions; escalation after 4 min.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Run 10 AI coding agents in parallel
execution_isolation.note: CLIs run in host tmux panes; Codex launched with --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Ashigaru only touch their own task/report pair
filesystem_access.note: Only for OpenCode via generated permissions; Claude default runs with bypass permissions (effectively full).

permission_model.evidence_quote: claude --dangerously-skip-permissions # first run only: OAuth + accept Bypass Permissions
permission_model.note: OpenCode per-role permissions via config/opencode-permissions.yaml (static_allowlist) reachable.

tracing.evidence_quote: Every instruction, report, and decision is a plain YAML file you can read, diff, and version-control.
tracing.note: YAML message records plus dashboard; closest to logs/structured.

replayability.note: No replay facility surface in evidence.

eval_hooks.note: Only tests; no benchmark runner in file tree.

target_domain.evidence_quote: This system manages **all white-collar tasks**, not just code.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Shogun isn't locked to one vendor. The system supports 7 CLI tools

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Samurai-inspired multi-agent system for Claude Code.
